name: St Robert of Newminster, Levenshulme
note: Amalgamation of St Mary (Levenshulme) and St Richard (Longsight)

boundary.description: From the junction of Pottery Lane and Hyde Road, E along Hyde Road, Kirkmanshulme Lane, Pink Bank Lane, (including Woodhill Close, Totland Close, Calbourne Close, Newsham Walk, Cullercoats Walk, Wylam Walk, Specton Walk), Longsight Road, Mount Road, Sandford Lane, Nelstrop Lane North and then by a beeline between Wilsthorpe Grove (St Mary’s parish) and Simon Freeman Close (St Joseph’s, Reddish parish) to and along Norfolk Avenue, Wellington Road North, Crossley Road, Grangethorpe Drive, N along Kingsway, Mossley Road and Birchfields Road, Birch Hall Lane, Stamford Road, Stockport Road, Stanley Grove to and N along the railway to and NE along Kirkmanshulme Lane to its junction with Hyde Road and Pottery Lane.

internalBoundaries.description: From the junction of Birchfields Road and Old Hall Lane, E along Old Hall Lane, Park Grove to its junction with Stockport Road.
